records.claim: Nine first-time graduate employees used a goal-attainment AI chatbot coach for four weeks in a qualitative study.
records.source_title: Exploring the use of a goal-attainment, artificial intelligence chatbot coach to support first-time graduate employees
records.limitations: Small sample, rules-based chatbot, perceptions rather than controlled outcome evidence.

records.claim: A chatbot study compared a text-only condition with 126 participants and a text-plus-images condition with 116 participants.
records.population: coachbot users in a short goal-attainment study
records.source_title: An exploration of the role of visuals and users imagery and verbal preferences on goal attainment and coaching chatbot adoption
records.limitations: Short-term perceived goal attainment; source record is used as a discovery lead and should be checked against the primary article before numerical reuse elsewhere.

records.claim: A preprint randomized 486 university students to a six-week generative-AI well-being app or waitlist control.
records.source_title: AI for Proactive Mental Health: A Multi-Institutional, Longitudinal, Randomized Controlled Trial
records.limitations: Preprint, student population, proactive well-being app, not general executive coaching.

records.claim: A workplace-coaching meta-analysis synthesized 20 studies with 957 participants.
records.source_title: The effectiveness of workplace coaching: a meta-analysis of contemporary psychologically informed coaching approaches
records.limitations: Human coaching evidence does not automatically transfer to AI coaching.
